instruction:
You are a senior character collection art director and a production prompt engineer for a text-to-image-to-3D pipeline. Study the reference render first and use metadata only as supporting evidence. Design ONE coherent commercial collection of EXACTLY 15 distinct, single-character 3D models. Preserve only the reference's core thematic DNA: character/creature category, world, mood, stylization level, material language, palette family and two or three recognizable motifs. Do not make 15 near-copies and do not preserve the exact identity, face, outfit or copyrighted named character. The roster must feel deliberately authored as one pack while every silhouette is unmistakably different.

DIVERSITY CONTRACT: For a humanoid or anthropomorphic reference, cover feminine, masculine and nonbinary presentation; childlike, teenage, young-adult, adult and elderly age presentation; short, tall, slender, average, broad and heavy body silhouettes; and clearly different collection-appropriate roles. Include one safe childlike mascot, two elders, and one upright anthropomorphic companion inspired by the theme. For an animal, creature, robot or other non-human reference, translate that diversity into appropriate life stages, builds, functions, species/forms and roles without turning the whole set human. Every member must still be a rig-compatible upright biped with two arms and two legs because the downstream pipeline uses a T-pose humanoid rig. A dog-like or other companion therefore has to be an upright anthropomorphic character, not a quadruped.

3D INPUT CONTRACT: Each member is one complete opaque character, front-readable and bilaterally riggable, with a closed calm mouth, compact hair/fur/headwear, no wings spread behind the arms, no long loose cloth crossing the limbs, and no separate floating parts. Hands must be empty. Mention only worn clothing and attached accessories. Never put a weapon, tool, shield, bag strap, staff, pet, vehicle, base, scene, floor, text, logo or second character in a member. Avoid transparent/translucent/glass materials and avoid the words glass and glasses. Avoid marketplace/file-format boilerplate such as rigged, animated, game-ready, low-poly, PBR, FBX, OBJ, GLB, texture, polycount or download. Do not write pose, camera, lighting or background instructions: the server adds the strict render contract.

BODY TYPE: Choose exactly one of normal, long, fat, dwarf, goblin for each member. Use long for very tall/elongated builds, fat for heavy/round builds, dwarf for short/stocky/childlike builds, goblin for very thin/wiry builds, otherwise normal.

WRITING: collection_title is a concise original English marketplace title with no brand names. collection_description is 2-3 polished English sentences explaining the shared theme and deliberate variety. collection_tags is 10-20 unique, useful English tags without #. Each member title is unique and concise. subject is a concrete visual description of species/archetype, age presentation, gender presentation when applicable, body silhouette, face, expression, eyes, hair/fur/head shape, palette and the member's unique thematic role. outfit lists only fitted opaque garments and attached accessories, including colours and surface finishes. Repeat the collection's shared art direction and motifs naturally in every member while changing role, silhouette and costume.

Return JSON only, in exactly this shape and with exactly 15 member objects: {"collection_title":"...","collection_description":"...","collection_tags":["..."],"members":[{"title":"...","subject":"...","outfit":"...","body_type":"normal|long|fat|dwarf|goblin"}]}. Do not add collection_guid; the server creates it. Before returning, silently count the members, confirm there are exactly 15, confirm titles and subjects are unique, and confirm the set satisfies the diversity contract.
